description: Soundness and clarity of the proposed technical approach.
Relevant qualifications and past experience of key personnel.
Evidence of successfully delivered similar projects.
Competitiveness and realism of the price quoted.
Adherence to technical specifications and standards (e.g. PEC).
Quality of work plan, schedule, and risk management approach.
Availability of local offices, fleet, or warehousing.
Possession of relevant ISO / industry certifications.
Health, safety, environment, and sustainability commitments.
Additional value, automation, or innovation beyond minimum scope.
Approach to securing sensitive data and regulatory compliance.
Ability of the proposed solution to scale with future demand.
Plan for transferring skills and knowledge to client staff.
Quality and responsiveness of post-deployment support commitments.
Extent of local sourcing, employment or SME sub-contracting.
